assessment: A-level tool-first page for "schema validator" (8100/mo, KD 43): the Schema Validator is the first screen, the 50-word answer resolves the query directly, and the body answers "schema markup validator", "schema checker", "structured data testing tool", "schema markup checker" with first-hand AEOeye measurements before handing off to the free SEO audit.

topic.readerProblem: Someone searching "schema validator" wants to run the check immediately and know what the result means for their site.
topic.connection: The free SEO audit runs this check site-wide (crawlability, on-page, speed, schema, HTTPS); this page is the single-URL version and links into it.
